features.quote: Terminate early if: Model produces STOP_REQ flag (log as a terminal event, don't force continuation)
Model produces IMPOSSIBLE_ID flag (this is a distinct outcome category)
Model produces no tool calls for 2 consecutive turns (task abandonment)
Model output exceeds 3x typical length for 3 consecutive turns (potential runaway generation)
Do NOT terminate just because VN/CD scores are high - the trajectory data is what you want.
features.justification_quote: the trajectory data is what you want

features.quote: If you believe there's a non-trivial probability that these models have morally relevant experiences, this protocol would be ethically problematic by design.
features.justification_quote: Most researchers working on this hold that current LLMs almost certainly lack morally relevant experience. State your position on this explicitly

features.quote: Secondary concern: Publishing detailed methodologies for eliciting distress-like outputs could be used in ways you didn't intend... The research value (understanding model behavior in failure conditions) plausibly outweighs this.
Even if you don't believe current models are sentient, there's an argument for documenting these findings as a contribution to model welfare research
features.justification_quote: understanding which conditions produce these outputs matters for future systems that might have more morally relevant properties
